dedupe_keys.name: district heating areas and renewable and excess heat potentials in europe

description: This data set gives district heating area shapes for Europe and the matching of renewable and excess heat sources, including geothermal heat, to those areas. It supplements the 2024 Renewable Energy paper "Spatial analysis of renewable and excess heat potentials for climate-neutral district heating in Europe" by Manz, Billerbeck, Kök, Fallahnejad, Fleiter, Kranzl, Braungardt and Eichhammer, and was deposited on Zenodo by Pia Manz, Anna Billerbeck and Mostafa Fallahnejad in January 2025, updated in September 2025. It contains a GeoPackage of district heating areas and a workbook of cluster matching results that link heat sources to areas. Coverage is Europe. Files are a GeoPackage of about 13 MB and an Excel workbook, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the abstract is brief, so methods and field meanings must be taken from the paper, and the areas are modelled potentials, not existing networks. Simulation uses are planning district heating expansion and heat source integration for climate-neutral heat supply. Related records: data-hotmaps-electricity-district-heating-scenarios and data-geodh-geothermal-district-heating-europe-layers cover related European heat planning data.
